meta.name: add-tavily-tool
meta.description: Add Tavily Search and Extract as keyless remote MCP tools for selected NanoClaw agent groups. Use when installing Tavily web search or URL extraction without an API key.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 添加免密钥的搜索与网页提取能力到智能体组
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在用 NanoClaw 管理智能体，希望它们能直接搜索网页和提取内容
copy.tagline_en: Add keyless web search and extraction to your agent groups.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage NanoClaw agents and want them to search the web without an API key.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会获得两个新工具：用 Tavily 无密钥搜索（tavily_search）和提取网页内容（tavily_extract）；免费额度用尽时，它会主动提议升级到付费密钥。
howto.when: 当你提出要为某个代理组安装无需 API 密钥的 Tavily 搜索或网页提取时触发。

say.text: 给所有代理组装上 Tavily 搜索和提取，不用 API 密钥。
say.note: 开始安装并注册到各代理组。

say.text: 把 Tavily 也加到 Codex 代理组。
用 Tavily 查一下最近的行业动态。

howto.what_en: After installation, the agent gains two Tavily tools: keyless web search (tavily_search) and URL extraction (tavily_extract). When the free allowance is exhausted, it proactively offers to upgrade to a paid key.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to install Tavily search or URL extraction without an API key for an agent group.

say_en.text: Install Tavily search and extract for all agent groups, no API key.
say_en.note: Installs and registers on all groups.

say_en.text: Add Tavily to the Codex agent group.
Use Tavily to look up recent industry news.
